text:
Maya: heads up — I'm seeing repeated p99 latency spikes on the KV path during sustained client bursts. looks like evictions + reinserts are creating a handshake misalignment between pager and reuse map. reproable on staging with long contexts :frowning:
Alex: can you paste the minimal repro? logs?
Maya: gist of steps:
```
# run the load generator against staging pool-3
./tools/loadgen --model redwood-v1 --seq 4096 --qps 200 --duration 6m --mix long-context
```
Then tail runtime logs for `kv_pager` and `evicter`. attach: staging heap profile + `kv_evict.log` (small snippet below).
Sam: log snippet?
Maya: `evicter: freeing 512 entries, reinserted=148, evict_latency_ms=24, pager_pressure=0.86, reuse_miss=0.27`
Priya: hmm reuse_miss that high during heavy paging is suspicious — are reinserts happening before the pager checkpoint finishes? could be ordering race.
Alex: saw something similar last month when FIFO reinserts happened without carrying forward the original seq metadata. FIFO path was reusing slot but not updating handshake epoch, so pager assumed item was safe to compact.
Jeff: that would cause the pager to discard a recently reinserted block, then a later request triggers a cold fetch — explains the latency spike.
Maya: confirmed with flamegraph — big CPU on `kv_pager::checkout_and_compact` and then blocking on `kv_rebuild_kvset`. p99 token latency jumps from ~70ms to ~430ms at the spike.
Sam: can you share the flame link?
Maya: https://staging-profiles/replay/2142223333/flame (short-lived) :eyes:
Priya: two quick mitigation ideas:
- stop reinserts during high pager_pressure (treat as cold miss)
- carry strong sequence/epoch on reinserts so pager sees them as fresh and skips compaction
Jeff: both make sense. Priya — the epoch idea requires a small header bump but should be safe. stopping reinserts is faster but costs more fetches.
Alex: also check batching heuristics — we saw that when kernel selection switches to small-batch kernels (seq>2k), the timing of KV callbacks changes and can expose ephemeral races. might be an orthogonal cause.
Maya: ran quick patch to gate reinserts when `pager_pressure > 0.8` and redeployed to staging (deploy id: dpl-2142). spikes dropped in the 6m run: p99 down to ~95ms, tail still has a few outliers.
ci-bot: deploy dpl-2142 to staging succeeded — 2142223360
Sam: good quick win. We should still do the epoch header change for correctness. Any perf cost?
Priya: header adds 8 bytes per entry and an atomic write on reinsert path — negligible compared to KV entry size for long contexts. will prototype.
Jeff: assign owners: Priya for epoch header PR, Alex for investigating kernel selection timing interaction, Maya to run longer soak. Sam will create an eval to measure cost of reinserts disabled.
Maya: created thread checklist in ticket RF-1289, linked to PRs.
Alex: one more ask — add metric `kv.reinsert_skipped` + `kv.pager_epoch_mismatch` so we can correlate with p99 spikes.
Priya: ack, adding metrics.
Maya: thanks all. will run 3h soak tonight and post results tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Jeff: nice triage. follow-up tomorrow after soak. :eyes:
Maya: (later) 3h soak finished: p99 stayed ~100ms, no 400ms spikes. saving profiles under /artifacts/2142223333/soak.
Sam: great, looks like gating reinserts bought us time for a proper fix.
Jeff: cool — moving to postmortem/next steps in RF-1289.
